# Framework7 9.3.0

Unmodified runtime assets from the official `framework7@9.3.0` npm package
(https://github.com/framework7io/framework7). MIT license included.

Bundled locally so the static GitHub Pages app and its service worker can load
without a CDN. No runtime build step is required.

To update, download an explicitly pinned npm package and replace both minified
files and LICENSE together. Update the service worker cache version and run the
browser checks before merging.
